title: estimate.load_ac_energy.v1 durable acknowledgement
description: HTTP body of POST /api/telemetry/energy-estimate after the database transaction commits. This object is also results[0] of POST /api/internal/ws/telemetry. The device websocket does not forward it.

replay.description: false on the commit that inserted the row. true when the same canonical record was already committed.

record_id.description: energy_estimate_records.id assigned at insert. Not chosen by firmware. A replay returns the original id.
